limits: Owned local synthetic exercise only. Instance markers prevent accidents and are not security attestations. HTTP cases use scoped API state reads. S02 independently reads the owned Compose PostgreSQL database in a read-only transaction. HTTP quota and rate rejections are guard decisions, not database-lock admissions. A12 requires a separate two-process PostgreSQL contention artifact. The teaching fixture uses a reduced actor model and is not the product login. Request latencies are observations, not a comparative benchmark. No security certification or production-scale performance claim is made.
